window_note: Upcoming events within one year are listed first; recurring series without a fixed date are listed as 'to be announced'.

events.name: SIPS 2027 — 6th International Conference of the Society for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies
events.location: State Library of New South Wales, Sydney, Australia
events.organizer: Society for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies (SIPS) / University of Sydney
events.description: The flagship biennial placebo/nocebo conference; theme 'Placebos in Practice: Translating Research into Clinical Impact'. Late-breaking poster submissions open; early-bird registration until 31 Oct 2026 (AUD 1,100–1,200 standard, 550–650 trainee); contact sips.conference@sydney.edu.au.

events.name: SIPS 2027 ECR Summer School (with SFB/TRR 289 travel grants)
events.organizer: SIPS / University of Sydney / CRC-TRR 289 Treatment Expectation
events.description: Free one-day pre-conference summer school for early-career researchers (talks by Charlotte Blease, Tom Hardwicke, Kate Faasse; lab demos, speed networking, clinician roundtables). Application deadline 1 Oct 2026 23:59 UTC; ECR travel grants supported by TRR 289 for those attending both summer school and conference.

events.name: IASP Pain and Placebo SIG Symposium: 'Advancing Placebo Research: Methodological Innovation, Expectation Measurement, and Bias Reduction'
events.organizer: IASP Pain and Placebo Special Interest Group
events.description: Half-day placebo methods symposium held on the SIG day preceding the IASP World Congress; speakers include Colloca, Lene Vase, Ben Colagiuri, Tor Wager, Patrick Finan, Przemysław Bąbel, Roi Treister, Yang Wang, Lewis Crawford. Three sessions: study design, expectation measurement, bias reduction.

events.name: IASP 2026 World Congress on Pain
events.location: Bangkok International Trade & Exhibition Centre (BITEC), Bangkok, Thailand
events.organizer: International Association for the Study of Pain (IASP)
events.description: Largest global pain meeting (~5,000 attendees), first time in Southeast Asia; includes the Pain and Placebo SIG symposium on 26 Oct and many placebo/expectation posters and topical workshops.

events.name: EFIC 2027 — Pain in Europe XV (15th Congress of the European Pain Federation)
events.location: Scottish Event Campus, Glasgow, United Kingdom
events.description: Europe's largest scientific pain congress; theme 'Building Bridges in Pain: Thriving Through Communication'. Abstract deadline 30 Sep 2026; late-breaking abstracts Dec 2026–Jan 2027; early-bird registration until 14 Dec 2026.

events.name: USASP 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting
events.location: Sheraton Denver Downtown, Denver, CO, USA
events.organizer: United States Association for the Study of Pain (USASP)
events.description: US national pain-research meeting (IASP chapter) with symposia and pre-conference workshops; 2027 calls for symposia and pre-conference workshops are open on the USASP events list.

events.name: SBSM (formerly American Psychosomatic Society) 84th Annual Meeting
events.organizer: Society for Biopsychosocial Science and Medicine (formerly APS)
events.description: Theme 'Biopsychosocial Mechanisms of Restorative Practices for Health and Healing Across the Lifespan'. Abstract deadline 9 Sep 2026 23:59 EST; registration opens Dec 2026. Historically a venue for placebo/expectation mechanism work.

events.name: Society for Affective Science (SAS) 2027 Annual Conference
events.description: Annual affective-science meeting relevant to expectation, appraisal, and placebo/nocebo affect research. Submissions open 1 Sep and close 2 Nov 2026; early-bird registration 1 Nov–1 Feb.

events.name: ISPNE 2026 — 55th Annual Meeting of the International Society of Psychoneuroendocrinology
events.location: Hörsaalzentrum Medizin, FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg, Erlangen, Germany
events.description: Theme 'Stress in Motion: From Signals to Society'; keynotes by Karin Roelofs, Steve Cole, Björn Schuller, Michèle Wessa. Relevant to neuroendocrine placebo/nocebo outcomes. Note: the meeting is happening the week this list was compiled.

events.name: ISPNE 2027 Annual Meeting
events.description: Annual psychoneuroendocrinology meeting, normally held Aug–Sep; 2027 dates and location had not been announced on ispne.net as of 2 Sep 2026.

events.name: Deutscher Schmerzkongress 2026 (German Pain Congress)
events.organizer: Deutsche Schmerzgesellschaft & Deutsche Migräne- und Kopfschmerzgesellschaft
events.description: Joint German pain and headache congress, motto 'Wandel bewegt'; TRR 289 Treatment Expectation groups regularly present placebo/nocebo work here.

events.name: Deutscher Schmerzkongress 2027
events.description: Next German Pain Congress, listed in the Deutsche Schmerzgesellschaft congress calendar (just outside the 12-month window but already dated).

events.name: APS–ISPP 2027: Australian Pain Society 47th ASM with the 16th International Symposium on Paediatric Pain
events.location: Gold Coast Convention & Exhibition Centre, Broadbeach, Queensland, Australia
events.description: Theme 'Pain Across the Lifespan'. Pre-conference workshops Tue 13 Apr 2027 (confirmed); main-meeting end date inferred from registration windows (last-minute registration to 16 Apr). Abstracts close 28 Sep 2026; early-bird to 29 Jan 2027.

events.name: PBO Center Accredited Hybrid Lecture Series (Placebo Beyond Opinions Center)
events.location: Hybrid — University of Maryland School of Nursing, Baltimore + Zoom
events.organizer: University of Maryland School of Nursing, Placebo Beyond Opinions (PBO) Center
events.description: Recurring academic-year lecture series by placebo/pain experts (2025–26 speakers: Karin Meissner, Michele Curatolo, Leonard Calabrese, Yoni Ashar; earlier Tor Wager, Przemysław Bąbel, Fadel Zeidan). 2026–27 dates not yet posted; contact nrscollocalab@umaryland.edu.

events.name: Harvard-wide Placebo Studies Seminar Series (PiPS)
events.location: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, MA (mailing-list announced)
events.organizer: Program in Placebo Studies & Therapeutic Encounter (PiPS), BIDMC / Harvard Medical School
events.description: Monthly seminar series running since 2011, open to the public; upcoming dates are distributed via mailing list only and the website's events archive is stale (last posted 2017). RSS at programinplacebostudies.org/feed/.

events.name: SFB/TRR 289 'Treatment Expectation' Virtual Webinar Series
events.description: Free English-language webinar series by international placebo/expectation researchers (2025 edition ran Mar–Sep 2025, four talks; registration via webinar@treatment-expectation.de). A 2026/27 edition had not been announced as of 2 Sep 2026; previous series are on the TRR 289 YouTube channel.

events.name: TRR 289 ECR Summer School 'Treatment Expectation'
events.location: Germany (rotating; 2027 edition folded into SIPS 2027 ECR Summer School, Sydney)
events.description: Recurring early-career summer school combining lectures on placebo/nocebo mechanisms with workshops on statistics and open science (previously hosted alongside SIPS 2023 Duisburg and SIPS 2025 Kraków). Next standalone edition not announced.

events.name: MS Wissenschaft 2026 — floating placebo/nocebo exhibition ('Meet the Scientist' events)
events.location: Exhibition ship: Aschaffenburg 1–3 Sep, Miltenberg 4–6 Sep, Würzburg 8–11 Sep, Krems 17–19 Sep, Tulln 20–22 Sep, Korneuburg 23–25 Sep, Vienna 26–30 Sep 2026
events.organizer: Wissenschaft im Dialog / CRC-TRR 289 Treatment Expectation
events.description: Public-science exhibition on placebo and nocebo effects touring 36 cities (7 May–30 Sep 2026) with TRR 289 'Meet the Scientist' events; final stops in September 2026 in Bavaria and Austria.

events.name: 'Wirkstoff Wort' podcast (TRR 289)
events.description: Monthly podcast on communication, expectation, and placebo/nocebo effects in medicine (episodes on plain language, numeric framing, treatment-goal conflicts). Useful as a recurring 'online talks' entry.

events.name: IPS Leiden lectures & PANACEA Summer School (Center for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies)
events.organizer: Center for Interdisciplinary Placebo Studies Leiden (IPS)
events.description: IPS hosts occasional guest lectures (e.g., Marij Hillen, 31 Mar 2026) and ran the PANACEA Summer School (2024, 2025). No 2026-27 events were listed as of 2 Sep 2026; the news page is the only channel (no RSS).

events.name: Australian Placebo Nocebo Symposium (Sydney Placebo Lab)
events.organizer: Sydney Placebo Lab, University of Sydney
events.description: One-day national placebo/nocebo symposium (2026 edition held 20 Feb 2026, New Law Building Annex, in person). In 2027 the community meeting is effectively SIPS 2027; a standalone 2027 edition has not been announced.

events.name: IASP Pain and Placebo SIG webinars & journal club
events.organizer: IASP Pain and Placebo Special Interest Group
events.description: SIG runs occasional online webinars (four in 2023, archived on YouTube/PERC) and a journal club (e.g., 19 Mar 2026 on placebo and brain age, listed on Pain Research Forum). New sessions appear on perc.iasp-pain.org/upcoming-webinars.

events.name: BPS Pain & Education webinar: 'Pain Management: Placebo or Nocebo?'
events.description: Example of placebo-specific webinar content in the BPS calendar (already past; recordings at britishpainsociety.org/resources/bps-webinars/). BPS 60th ASM 2027 date not yet listed.

events.name: ICBM 2027 — 19th International Congress of Behavioral Medicine
events.location: Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre, Singapore
events.description: Theme 'The Transformative Power of Behavioral Medicine: Time to Act'. Abstracts open 1 Sep 2026, deadline 8 Jan 2027; early-bird registration until 18 Mar 2027.

events.name: Society of Behavioral Medicine (SBM) 2027 Annual Meeting
events.description: Theme 'Partnerships that Produce: Real-World Applications of Our Science'; regular venue for expectation, open-label placebo, and patient–clinician communication research.

events.name: ICPM 2026 — 28th World Congress of the International College of Psychosomatic Medicine
events.location: Fukuoka International Congress Center, Fukuoka, Japan
events.description: Theme 'Revitalizing Psychosomatic Medicine: Asian Perspectives and Global Integration'. The previous congress (Tübingen 2024) was co-organized by the Tübingen placebo group (Enck/Weimer).

events.name: Deutscher Kongress für Psychosomatische Medizin und Psychotherapie 2027
events.location: Henry-Ford-Bau, Freie Universität Berlin, Berlin, Germany
events.description: German psychosomatic medicine congress, theme 'Zukunft der Psychosomatik: Zwischen Menschlichkeit, Wissenschaft und Digitalisierung'; TRR 289 placebo/expectation groups typically present here.

events.name: Society for Psychophysiological Research (SPR) 66th Annual Meeting
events.location: Halifax Convention Centre, Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada (pre-conference workshops 13 Oct)
events.description: Psychophysiology meeting relevant to autonomic/EEG outcome measures in placebo research.

events.name: Neuroscience 2026 (Society for Neuroscience)
events.location: Walter E. Washington Convention Center, Washington, DC, USA
events.description: Largest neuroscience meeting; late-breaking abstracts open 8 Sep 2026. Relevant for placebo analgesia and expectation neuroimaging work.

events.name: ACNP 65th Annual Meeting
events.location: Manchester Grand Hyatt, San Diego, CA, USA
events.description: Neuropsychopharmacology meeting where placebo response in psychiatric trials is a recurring topic.

events.name: EHPS 2026 — 40th Annual Conference of the European Health Psychology Society
events.location: Coral Beach Hotel and Resort, Pafos, Cyprus
events.description: Health-psychology meeting with placebo/nocebo, expectation and side-effect communication sessions; 2027 host not yet announced.

events.name: PNIRS 2027 Annual Meeting
events.description: Annual PNI meeting (usually June); 2027 confirmed for Columbus, OH but dates not yet posted.

events.name: Canadian Pain Society 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting
events.description: Annual Canadian pain meeting (usually late April/May); 2027 confirmed for Toronto, dates to be announced.

events.name: British Pain Society 60th Annual Scientific Meeting (2027)
events.description: Annual BPS ASM (usually April/May); 2027 date and venue not yet on the BPS events calendar.

events.name: European Pain School 2027 (Siena)
events.description: Week-long PhD/postdoc pain school held each June; 2027 applications closed 30 Jun 2026 and exact dates are not yet published.

events.name: Erasmus Summer Programme course EL028 'The Placebo Effect'
events.description: One-week graduate course on placebo mechanisms (expectancy, conditioning, affect, communication) with an in-class placebo experiment; the 2026 edition ran 9–13 Feb 2026 (EUR 1,012). 2027 dates not yet published.

events.name: Pain Research Forum webinars & journal clubs
events.description: Free online webinars and journal clubs (several per month) that periodically cover placebo analgesia and expectation; machine-readable calendar available (RSS and ICS).

events.name: IASP PERC upcoming webinars
events.description: Central listing of IASP SIG webinars (including any Pain and Placebo SIG sessions); September 2026 slate has no placebo-specific talk.
